translation:
Removes all films and barriers.

Pearl (3 qian), amber (3 qian), crystal (3 qian), dragon tooth (1 qian), Shijueming (3 qian), bear gall (3 qian), borneol (add 5 fen freshly).

Pound the above into pieces and grind fine. In five sheng of water, decoct in an earthen pot down to one sheng, remove the dregs, then reduce in a silver pot to one cup, add five qian of clean white honey, and blend into an ointment. Apply it every night after lying down; do not apply it in the morning.
translator_notes: 去粗 (qucu) means straining off the dregs.
